## Role in the pipeline

| | |
|---|---|
| **Thesis section** | Appendix |
| **Previous file** | `07_robustness_checks.qmd` |

| Robustness check | What it is | Filter / change vs. main specification |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | without country x year FE | `fe` drops `country^fyear` |
| R2 | without industry x year FE | `fe` drops `sic2^fyear` |
| R3 | without firm FE | `fe` drops `gvkey` |
| R4 | without control variables | `ctrl = NULL` |
| R5 | firm-specific linear trend | `fe` adds `gvkey[t_c]` |
| R6 | one-year growth horizon | `y = "growth_f1_w"` |
| R7 | alliance window (year t / 2y / 4y / 5y) | alliance counts use a different window suffix |
| R8 | placebo: growth t-6 to t-3 | `y` = placebo growth, no `growth_l1_w` control |
| R9 | excluding SDC coverage gap 2009-2015 | `data = d[!(fyear %between% c(2009, 2015))]` |
| R10 | revenue floor: USD 20m / no floor | `data = d[revt_usd_lag >= 20]` or `d_nofloor` |
| R11 | United States / non-United States firms | `data = d[country == "USA"]` / `d[country != "USA"]` |
| R12 | below- / above-median firm size | `data = d[ln_at_usd <= med_size]` / `d[ln_at_usd > med_size]` |

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("00_config.R")
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(countrycode)
library(scales)

out <- file.path(path, "appendix_out_v2")

unlink(out, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(out)

d  <- readRDS(file.path(path, "analysis_sample.rds"))
fp <- readRDS(file.path(path, "firmyear_panel.rds"))
af <- readRDS(file.path(path, "alliances_focal.rds"))
d[, sic2 := as.factor(sic2)]

# alliance-firm observations inside the analysis sample (same construction as 05)
af_s <- af[d[, .(gvkey, fyear)], on = .(gvkey, year = fyear), nomatch = 0]

c(firm_years = nrow(d), firms = uniqueN(d$gvkey), countries = uniqueN(d$country),
  alliance_firm_obs = nrow(af_s))
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
wins <- function(x, p = 0.01) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(p, 1 - p), na.rm = TRUE)
  pmin(pmax(x, q[1]), q[2])
}
diff_test <- function(m, a, b) {
  v   <- vcov(m)
  est <- coef(m)[[a]] - coef(m)[[b]]
  se  <- sqrt(v[a, a] + v[b, b] - 2 * v[a, b])
  c(est = est, se = se, t = est / se, p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
}
joint_p <- function(m, pattern = "^log1p\\(d") wald(m, keep = pattern, print = FALSE)$p
omnibus_p <- function(m, pattern = "^log1p\\(d") {
  nm <- grep(pattern, names(coef(m)), value = TRUE)
  R <- matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 5)
  for (i in 1:4) { R[i, i] <- 1; R[i, i + 1] <- -1 }
  rb   <- R %*% coef(m)[nm]
  stat <- as.numeric(t(rb) %*% solve(R %*% vcov(m)[nm, nm] %*% t(R)) %*% rb)
  pchisq(stat, df = 4, lower.tail = FALSE)
}

controls <- "ln_at_usd + roa_w + leverage_w + growth_l1_w"
fe_main  <- "gvkey + sic2^fyear + country^fyear"

est <- function(rhs, fe = fe_main, y = "growth_f3_w", data = d, ctrl = controls) {
  rhs_all <- if (is.null(ctrl)) rhs else paste(rhs, "+", ctrl)
  feols(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ ", rhs_all, " | ", fe)), data = data, cluster = ~gvkey)
}

rhs_h1   <- "log1p(n_rel_3y) + log1p(n_unrel_3y)"
rhs_dist <- function(suffix) paste0("log1p(", cats, suffix, ")", collapse = " + ")
rhs_h2   <- rhs_dist("_3y")
rhs_h3   <- paste("log1p(n_rel_eq_3y) + log1p(n_rel_ne_3y)",
                  "log1p(n_unrel_eq_3y) + log1p(n_unrel_ne_3y)", sep = " + ")
rhs_h4   <- paste0(c(rbind(paste0("log1p(", cats, "_eq_3y)"), paste0("log1p(", cats, "_ne_3y)"))),
                   collapse = " + ")

# exact row labels as they appear in the thesis (Tables 1, 8-11)
cat_labels_paper <- c(d0_same4 = "D0 (same four-digit SIC)", d1_same3 = "D1 (same three-digit SIC)",
                      d2_same2 = "D2 (same major group)", d3_same_division = "D3 (same SIC division)",
                      d4_diff_division = "D4 (different SIC division)")

# The "no revenue floor" version of the sample (same filters as the main sample,
# minus the revt_usd_lag >= 10 step) -- needed both for the R10 robustness model
# (Appendix B) and to show, descriptively, what the revenue floor is cutting
# (Appendix A, Figure A8). Rebuilt from the raw panel because the alliance-window
# variables have to be recomputed before the floor is applied (see 07, Panel E).
fp_raw <- copy(fp)
fp_raw[, fyear3 := fyear + 3L]
fp_raw[fp_raw, on = .(gvkey, fyear3 = fyear), `:=`(revt_f3 = i.revt, curcd_f3 = i.curcd)]
fp_raw[, growth_f3 := fifelse(revt > 0 & revt_f3 > 0 & curcd == curcd_f3, (revt_f3 / revt)^(1/3) - 1, NA_real_)]
fp_raw[, `:=`(growth_f3_w = wins(growth_f3), growth_l1_w = wins(growth_l1), roa_w = wins(roa), leverage_w = wins(leverage))]
for (k in cats) fp_raw[, (k) := get(paste0(k, "_eq")) + get(paste0(k, "_ne"))]
setorder(fp_raw, gvkey, fyear)
fp_raw[, `:=`(fy_m1 = fyear - 1L, fy_m2 = fyear - 2L)]
for (v in cats) {
  src <- fp_raw[, .(gvkey, fyear, val = get(v))]
  fp_raw[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m1 = fyear), m1 := i.val]
  fp_raw[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m2 = fyear), m2 := i.val]
  fp_raw[, (paste0(v, "_3y")) := get(v) + fcoalesce(m1, 0L) + fcoalesce(m2, 0L)]
  fp_raw[, c("m1", "m2") := NULL]
}
d_nofloor <- fp_raw[!(financial %in% TRUE)]
d_nofloor <- d_nofloor[!is.na(sic2) & !(as.integer(as.character(sic2)) %in% c(49, 99))]
d_nofloor <- d_nofloor[!is.na(growth_f3_w) & !is.na(ln_at_usd) & !is.na(roa) & !is.na(leverage) & !is.na(growth_l1)]
d_nofloor[, sic2 := as.factor(sic2)]
cat("no-floor sample:", nrow(d_nofloor), " | main sample (floor = USD 10m):", nrow(d), "\n")
```

# Appendix A: Sample Description

This section describes the analysis sample by country, region, firm size and
time.

## A1. Firm-years and firms by country

```{r}
#| label: appx-a1-country
by_country <- d[, .(firm_years = .N, firms = uniqueN(gvkey)), by = country][order(-firm_years)]
by_country[, `:=`(share_firm_years_pct = round(100 * firm_years / sum(firm_years), 1))]

top_n <- 15
tabA1 <- rbind(
  by_country[1:top_n],
  by_country[(top_n + 1):.N, .(country = "Other", firm_years = sum(firm_years),
                                firms = sum(firms), share_firm_years_pct = round(100 * sum(firm_years) / sum(by_country$firm_years), 1))])
knitr::kable(tabA1, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A1: Firm-years and firms by country (top 15, Compustat country of incorporation/location)")
fwrite(tabA1, file.path(out, "table_appx_A1_country.csv"))
fwrite(by_country, file.path(out, "table_appx_A1_country_full.csv"))  # ungrouped, for your own checking

p_A1 <- ggplot(tabA1[country != "Other"], aes(x = reorder(country, firm_years), y = firm_years)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey25", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Firm-years", title = "Figure A1: Firm-years by country (top 15)") +
  theme_thesis()
p_A1
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_A1_country.png"), p_A1, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## A2. Firm-years and firms by region

```{r}
#| label: appx-a2-region
fix_region <- c(ANT = "Caribbean")  # Netherlands Antilles (dissolved 2010); not in countrycode's iso3c table
region_map <- countrycode(unique(d$country), origin = "iso3c", destination = "region23", warn = FALSE)
names(region_map) <- unique(d$country)
unmapped <- names(region_map)[is.na(region_map)]
if (length(unmapped) > 0) cat("Unmapped country codes (add to fix_region if frequent):\n",
                              paste(unmapped, collapse = ", "), "\n")
region_map[names(fix_region)] <- fix_region

d[, region := region_map[country]]
d[is.na(region), region := "Unmapped"]

by_region <- d[, .(firm_years = .N, firms = uniqueN(gvkey), countries = uniqueN(country)), by = region][order(-firm_years)]
by_region[, share_pct := round(100 * firm_years / sum(firm_years), 1)]
knitr::kable(by_region, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A2: Firm-years, firms and countries by region")
fwrite(by_region, file.path(out, "table_appx_A2_region.csv"))

p_A2 <- ggplot(by_region, aes(x = reorder(region, firm_years), y = firm_years)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey25", width = 0.7) + coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Firm-years", title = "Figure A2: Firm-years by region") +
  theme_thesis()
p_A2
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_A2_region.png"), p_A2, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

## A3. Distance categories by firm location (United States vs. rest of sample) -- underlies R11

```{r}
#| label: appx-a3-us-split
af_s[, cat_label := factor(cat_labels_paper[category], levels = cat_labels_paper)]
af_s[d, on = .(gvkey, year = fyear), `:=`(us_firm = i.country == "USA", region = i.region)]

tabA3 <- af_s[, .N, by = .(us_firm, cat_label)]
tabA3[, share := round(100 * N / sum(N), 1), by = us_firm]
tabA3_wide <- dcast(tabA3, cat_label ~ us_firm, value.var = c("N", "share"))
setnames(tabA3_wide, c("cat_label", "N_FALSE", "N_TRUE", "share_FALSE", "share_TRUE"),
         c("Distance category", "Obs. (non-US)", "Obs. (US)", "Share % (non-US)", "Share % (US)"))
knitr::kable(tabA3_wide, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A3: Alliance-firm observations by distance category, United States vs. rest of sample (underlies R11)")
fwrite(tabA3_wide, file.path(out, "table_appx_A3_us_split.csv"))

# how many firm-years / firms does each side of the R11 split actually have?
d[, .(firm_years = .N, firms = uniqueN(gvkey)), by = .(us_firm = country == "USA")]
```

## A4. Distance categories by firm size (below- / above-median) -- underlies R12

```{r}
#| label: appx-a4-size-split
med_size <- median(d$ln_at_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
af_s[d, on = .(gvkey, year = fyear), below_median := i.ln_at_usd <= med_size]

tabA4 <- af_s[, .N, by = .(below_median, cat_label)]
tabA4[, share := round(100 * N / sum(N), 1), by = below_median]
tabA4_wide <- dcast(tabA4, cat_label ~ below_median, value.var = c("N", "share"))
setnames(tabA4_wide, c("cat_label", "N_FALSE", "N_TRUE", "share_FALSE", "share_TRUE"),
         c("Distance category", "Obs. (above median)", "Obs. (below median)",
           "Share % (above median)", "Share % (below median)"))
knitr::kable(tabA4_wide, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A4: Alliance-firm observations by distance category, below- vs. above-median firm size (underlies R12)")
fwrite(tabA4_wide, file.path(out, "table_appx_A4_size_split.csv"))

d[, .(firm_years = .N, firms = uniqueN(gvkey), median_size_usd_m = round(exp(med_size), 0)),
  by = .(below_median = ln_at_usd <= med_size)]
```

## A5. Summary statistics by region and by size group

```{r}
#| label: appx-a5-summary-by-split
sum_vars <- c(growth_f3_w = "Revenue growth, g (t to t+3)", ln_at_usd = "Size (ln total assets, USD)",
              roa_w = "ROA", leverage_w = "Leverage", n_alliances_3y = "All alliances")

summarise_by <- function(byvar) {
  rbindlist(lapply(names(sum_vars), function(v) {
    d[, .(variable = sum_vars[[v]], mean = round(mean(get(v)), 3),
          median = round(median(get(v)), 3), sd = round(sd(get(v)), 3), N = .N),
      by = byvar]
  }))
}

tabA5a <- summarise_by("region")
knitr::kable(tabA5a, caption = "Table A5a: Summary statistics by region")
fwrite(tabA5a, file.path(out, "table_appx_A5a_by_region.csv"))

d[, size_group := fifelse(ln_at_usd <= med_size, "Below median", "Above median")]
tabA5b <- summarise_by("size_group")
knitr::kable(tabA5b, caption = "Table A5b: Summary statistics by size group")
fwrite(tabA5b, file.path(out, "table_appx_A5b_by_size.csv"))
```

## A7. Firm-years by year, and number of distinct firms/countries per year

Complements Figure 5 (which counts alliances, but not firm-years).

```{r}
#| label: appx-a7-by-year
tabA7 <- d[, .(firm_years = .N, firms = uniqueN(gvkey), countries = uniqueN(country)), by = fyear][order(fyear)]
knitr::kable(tabA7, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Table A7: Firm-years, firms and countries by year")
fwrite(tabA7, file.path(out, "table_appx_A7_by_year.csv"))

# No SDC-gap shading here: these are Compustat firm-years, which is not the
# series that has a 2009-2015 coverage gap (that gap is in the SDC alliance
# data -- see the main text's discussion of SDC coverage). Shading it here
# would just invite the reader to look for a dip that isn't there.
p_A7a <- ggplot(tabA7, aes(x = fyear, y = firm_years)) +
  geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2020, 5)) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Firm-years", title = "(a) Firm-years per year") + theme_thesis()
p_A7b <- ggplot(tabA7, aes(x = fyear, y = countries)) +
  geom_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2020, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Distinct countries", title = "(b) Country coverage per year") + theme_thesis()
fig_A7 <- p_A7a + p_A7b
fig_A7
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_A7_by_year.png"), fig_A7, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## A8. What the revenue floor is cutting -- underlies R10

The main sample has a USD 10m revenue floor. R10 in Table 11 asks how
much that choice matters,in two ways: (1) by raising the floor to USD 20m (does the
result survive on an even cleaner sample?) and (2) by removing it entirely (does the
result survive when small firms come back in?). This table and figure show,
in firm-years, exactly what each of those two moves would add or remove.

```{r}
#| label: appx-a8-revenue-floor
tabA8 <- data.table(
  sample = c("Main (floor = USD 10m)", "Stricter (floor = USD 20m)", "No floor"),
  firm_years = c(nrow(d), nrow(d[revt_usd_lag >= 20]), nrow(d_nofloor)),
  vs_main = c(0, nrow(d[revt_usd_lag >= 20]) - nrow(d), nrow(d_nofloor) - nrow(d)))
knitr::kable(tabA8, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A8: Firm-years under each revenue-floor variant tested in R10")
fwrite(tabA8, file.path(out, "table_appx_A8_revenue_floor.csv"))

# Distribution of revt_usd_lag among firm-years that are sample-eligible on
# every OTHER criterion (d_nofloor) -- i.e. exactly the population the floor
# decision is drawn from, not the raw, unfiltered panel (which also contains
# financial firms, excluded industries, etc. that the floor choice never
# touches either way).
bins <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50, 100, Inf)
tabA8b <- d_nofloor[, .N, by = .(bin = cut(revt_usd_lag, bins, right = FALSE))][order(bin)]
knitr::kable(tabA8b, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table A8b: Firm-years by lagged revenue bin, USD million (sample-eligible except for the floor)")
fwrite(tabA8b, file.path(out, "table_appx_A8b_revenue_bins.csv"))

p_A8 <- ggplot(d_nofloor[revt_usd_lag >= 0 & revt_usd_lag < 60], aes(x = revt_usd_lag)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "grey25", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(10, 20), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = c(10, 20), y = Inf, label = c("USD 10m (main)", "USD 20m (R10)"), vjust = 1.3, hjust = -0.1,
           family = "Times New Roman", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Revenue in t-1, USD million (truncated at 60)", y = "Firm-years",
       title = "Figure A8: Where the revenue floor sits in the eligible sample") +
  theme_thesis()
p_A8
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_A8_revenue_floor.png"), p_A8, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## A10. Industry distance between alliance partners, by decade

```{r}
#| label: appx-a10-distance-over-time
af_s[, cat_label := factor(cat_labels[category], levels = cat_labels)]
af_s[, period := paste0((year %/% 10) * 10, "s")]

tabA10 <- af_s[, .N, by = .(period, cat_label)]
tabA10[, share := round(N / sum(N), 3), by = period]
tabA10_wide <- dcast(tabA10, cat_label ~ period, value.var = "share")
overall10   <- af_s[, .N, by = cat_label][, .(cat_label, all_years = round(N / sum(N), 3))]
tabA10_wide <- overall10[tabA10_wide, on = "cat_label"]
knitr::kable(tabA10_wide, caption = "Table A10: Industry distance between alliance partners, by decade")
fwrite(tabA10_wide, file.path(out, "table_appx_A10_distance_by_decade.csv"))

figA10 <- ggplot(af_s[, .N, by = .(year, cat_label)],
                 aes(x = year, y = N, fill = cat_label)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.9, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.15, end = 0.95) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of alliances", fill = NULL,
       title = "Figure A10: Industry distance between alliance partners, 1990-2021") +
  theme_thesis()
figA10
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_A10_distance_by_year.png"), figA10, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

## B2. Robustness checks: full coefficients where they add something, p-values for all twelve

```{r}
#| label: appx-b2-robustness-models
d[, sic2 := as.factor(sic2)]
d[, t_c := as.numeric(fyear) - 2005]   # centred year, needed for gvkey[t_c] firm-specific linear trends (R5; same convention as file 07)
med_size <- median(d$ln_at_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
# d_nofloor was built in the setup chunk above (also used by Figure A8)

m_R1  <- est(rhs_h2, fe = "gvkey + sic2^fyear")
m_R2  <- est(rhs_h2, fe = "gvkey + country^fyear")
m_R3  <- est(rhs_h2, fe = "sic2^fyear + country^fyear")
m_R4  <- est(rhs_h2, ctrl = NULL)
m_R5  <- est(rhs_h2, fe = "gvkey[t_c] + sic2^fyear + country^fyear")
m_R6  <- est(rhs_h2, y = "growth_f1_w")
# R7: four alliance-window variants (year t only -- the bare, un-windowed counts -- plus 2y/4y/5y; see 04_analysis_sample.qmd)
m_R7_t  <- est(rhs_dist(""))
m_R7_w2 <- est(rhs_dist("_w2"))
m_R7_w4 <- est(rhs_dist("_w4"))
m_R7_w5 <- est(rhs_dist("_w5"))

# R8: placebo test, growth t-6 to t-3 (before the alliance window even opens).
# Ported from 07_robustness_checks.qmd's Panel B construction.
rv <- fp[, .(gvkey, fyear, revt, curcd)]
add_rev <- function(dt, k, name) {
  x <- rv[, .(gvkey, fyear = fyear - as.integer(k), r = revt, cur = curcd)]
  cols <- c(name, paste0(name, "_cur"))
  setnames(x, c("r", "cur"), cols)
  dt[x, on = .(gvkey, fyear), (cols) := mget(paste0("i.", cols))]
  dt
}
ann <- function(r1, c1, r0, c0, n) fifelse(r1 > 0 & r0 > 0 & c1 == c0, (r1 / r0)^(1 / n) - 1, NA_real_)
d <- add_rev(d, -6, "r_m6")
d <- add_rev(d, -3, "r_m3")
d[, g_pre := wins(ann(r_m3, r_m3_cur, r_m6, r_m6_cur, 3))]   # growth t-6 to t-3
ctrl_placebo <- "ln_at_usd + roa_w + leverage_w"   # past growth is dropped: it lies after the outcome period
m_R8a <- est(rhs_h2, y = "g_pre", ctrl = ctrl_placebo)
m_R8b <- est(rhs_h2, y = "g_pre", ctrl = NULL)

m_R9  <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[!(fyear %between% c(2009, 2015))])
m_R10a <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[revt_usd_lag >= 20])
m_R10b <- est(rhs_h2, data = d_nofloor)
m_R11a <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[country == "USA"])
m_R11b <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[country != "USA"])
m_R12a <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[ln_at_usd <= med_size])
m_R12b <- est(rhs_h2, data = d[ln_at_usd >  med_size])

dict_appx <- c(cat_labels_paper, ln_at_usd = "Size (ln assets, USD)", roa_w = "ROA",
               leverage_w = "Leverage", growth_l1_w = "Past growth")

# Full coefficients only for R3 and R4: these are the two where the omnibus/
# joint p-values in Table 11 actually move (R3 and R4 both go to p < 0.01),
# so seeing the coefficient pattern tells you something -- most likely that
# dropping the firm FE (R3) or the controls (R4) lets between-firm variation
# leak back into the estimate. R1, R2, R5 and R6 all land close to the main
# result (Table 11 p-values 0.26-0.60), so a full coefficient table for them
# would just re-confirm "nothing changed" -- the p-value cross-check further
# below covers that without spending appendix space on it.
etable(m2_full, m_R3, m_R4,
       headers = c("Main", "R3 (no firm FE)", "R4 (no controls)"),
       dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2,
       file = file.path(out, "table_appx_B2a_robustness_R3_R4.txt"), replace = TRUE)
tab_appx_b2a <- etable(m2_full, m_R3, m_R4,
       headers = c("Main", "R3 (no firm FE)", "R4 (no controls)"), dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2, tex = FALSE)
knitr::kable(tab_appx_b2a)

etable(m2_full, m_R7_t, m_R7_w2, m_R7_w4, m_R7_w5,
       headers = c("Main (3y)", "R7 (year t only)", "R7 (2y window)", "R7 (4y window)", "R7 (5y window)"),
       dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2,
       file = file.path(out, "table_appx_B2b_robustness_R7.txt"), replace = TRUE)
tab_appx_b2b <- etable(m2_full, m_R7_t, m_R7_w2, m_R7_w4, m_R7_w5,
       headers = c("Main (3y)", "R7 (year t only)", "R7 (2y window)", "R7 (4y window)", "R7 (5y window)"),
       dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2, tex = FALSE)
knitr::kable(tab_appx_b2b)

etable(m2_full, m_R8a, m_R8b, m_R9, m_R10a, m_R10b, m_R11a, m_R11b, m_R12a, m_R12b,
       headers = c("Main", "R8 (placebo, controls)", "R8 (placebo, no controls)", "R9", "R10 (20m)",
                   "R10 (no floor)", "R11 (US)", "R11 (non-US)", "R12 (below med.)", "R12 (above med.)"),
       dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2,
       file = file.path(out, "table_appx_B2c_robustness_R8_R12.txt"), replace = TRUE)
tab_appx_b2c <- etable(m2_full, m_R8a, m_R8b, m_R9, m_R10a, m_R10b, m_R11a, m_R11b, m_R12a, m_R12b,
       headers = c("Main", "R8 (placebo, controls)", "R8 (placebo, no controls)", "R9", "R10 (20m)",
                   "R10 (no floor)", "R11 (US)", "R11 (non-US)", "R12 (below med.)", "R12 (above med.)"),
       dict = dict_appx, fitstat = ~ n + r2 + wr2, tex = FALSE)
knitr::kable(tab_appx_b2c)

# p-values, to cross-check these line up with the existing Table 11
tab_pcheck <- rbindlist(lapply(list(R1 = m_R1, R2 = m_R2, R3 = m_R3, R4 = m_R4, R5 = m_R5, R6 = m_R6,
                       `R7 (t only)` = m_R7_t, `R7 (2y)` = m_R7_w2, `R7 (4y)` = m_R7_w4, `R7 (5y)` = m_R7_w5,
                       `R8 (ctrl)` = m_R8a, `R8 (no ctrl)` = m_R8b, R9 = m_R9,
                       `R10 (20m)` = m_R10a, `R10 (no floor)` = m_R10b,
                       `R11 (US)` = m_R11a, `R11 (non-US)` = m_R11b,
                       `R12 (below)` = m_R12a, `R12 (above)` = m_R12b),
                  function(m) data.table(omnibus_p = round(omnibus_p(m), 4), joint_p = round(joint_p(m), 4))),
          idcol = "check")
knitr::kable(tab_pcheck)
```

## B3. Exit rates by closest alliance distance category

```{r}
#| label: appx-b3-attrition
full <- copy(fp)
for (k in cats) full[, (k) := get(paste0(k, "_eq")) + get(paste0(k, "_ne"))]
setorder(full, gvkey, fyear)
full[, fyear3 := fyear + 3L]
full[full, on = .(gvkey, fyear3 = fyear), `:=`(revt_f3 = i.revt, curcd_f3 = i.curcd)]
full[, has_t3 := as.integer(fifelse(revt > 0 & !is.na(revt_f3) & revt_f3 > 0 & curcd == curcd_f3, TRUE, FALSE, na = FALSE))]
full <- full[!(financial %in% TRUE)]
full <- full[!is.na(sic2) & !(as.integer(as.character(sic2)) %in% c(49, 99))]
full <- full[revt_usd_lag >= 10]
full[, fy_m1 := fyear - 1L]; full[, fy_m2 := fyear - 2L]
for (v in cats) {
  src <- full[, .(gvkey, fyear, val = get(v))]
  full[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m1 = fyear), m1 := i.val]
  full[src, on = .(gvkey, fy_m2 = fyear), m2 := i.val]
  full[, (paste0(v, "_3y")) := get(v) + fcoalesce(m1, 0L) + fcoalesce(m2, 0L)]
  full[, c("m1", "m2") := NULL]
}
full[, closest := fifelse(d0_same4_3y > 0, "D0", fifelse(d1_same3_3y > 0, "D1",
            fifelse(d2_same2_3y > 0, "D2", fifelse(d3_same_division_3y > 0, "D3",
            fifelse(d4_diff_division_3y > 0, "D4", "No alliance")))))]

tabB3 <- full[, .(firm_years = .N, share_without_growth = round(1 - mean(has_t3), 3)), by = closest]
tabB3 <- tabB3[match(c("D0", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4", "No alliance"), closest)]
knitr::kable(tabB3, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Table B3: Exit rates by closest alliance distance category")
fwrite(tabB3, file.path(out, "table_appx_B3_attrition.csv"))
```

# Appendix C: Supplementary Figures

## C1. Coefficient patterns across all twelve robustness checks

```{r}
#| label: appx-c1-coef-panels
coef_df <- function(m, label) {
  ct <- as.data.table(coeftable(m), keep.rownames = "term")[grepl("^log1p\\(d", term)]
  ct[, `:=`(category = factor(cat_labels_paper, levels = cat_labels_paper), check = label,
            est_pp = 100 * Estimate, lo = 100 * (Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
            hi = 100 * (Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`))]
  ct[, .(category, check, est_pp, lo, hi)]
}

panel_models <- list(`(a) R1: without country FE` = m_R1, `(b) R2: without industry FE` = m_R2,
                     `(c) R9: excl. 2009-2015` = m_R9, `(d) R10: USD 20m floor` = m_R10a,
                     `(e) R10: no revenue floor` = m_R10b, `(f) R11: non-US firms` = m_R11b)
panel_data <- rbindlist(Map(coef_df, panel_models, names(panel_models)))
panel_data[, check := factor(check, levels = names(panel_models))]

p_C1 <- ggplot(panel_data, aes(x = category, y = est_pp)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = check)) +
  facet_wrap(~check, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("D0", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4")) +
  labs(x = "Industry distance between partners", y = "Effect on annualised growth (pp)",
       title = "Figure C1: Coefficient patterns for six further robustness checks") +
  theme_thesis() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
p_C1
ggsave(file.path(out, "fig_appx_C1_robustness_panels.png"), p_C1, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```
